message: The other day, I was rummaging through some old boxes and stumbled upon my childhood fire escape plan. It was a simple drawing of our house with arrows showing where to go in case of a fire. It got me thinking about how we often overlook the basics in favor of shiny gadgets. Rediscovering that low-tech fun reminded me that sometimes the best safety plans are the ones we create as a family. Have you ever made an escape plan with your loved ones? What was your favorite part?
